items.title: Eddie Johnson Interview, 1962-11-06
items.q: And this Knox, they used to play, they played bass drum here.

ctx.x: Oh, you mentioned Knox from Baton Rouge. What did you say he played? Drums. Now, that's not the Knox. It's here. No, no, no, no. No relation even much.

Mm-hmm. See, now, this Knox, he lived in Baton Rouge now. He never comes to New Orleans, you know. And this Knox, they used to play, they played bass drum here. Mm-hmm. They went all together. Mm-hmm. No relation.

I just wondered. I'd forgotten about that. You've had several drummers down there, I think, too. I don't remember who's been there through the years. Where? At the Harmony Inn, now that I think about it. Yeah. Let's see. Did Montague play with you for a while?
